correctness.rationale: A boundary-value solution provides the exact hypergeometric Laplace transform, the Bessel product proves the sum-of-exponentials law, and analytic moment differentiation, a precise square-root Laplace large-deviation argument, a rigorously bounded first Bessel zero and the weighted Rayleigh variational principle prove the announced strict inequalities and regularization. The standalone standard-library checker reproduces 0F1 moments, eigenvalue inequalities, and a regularized example. No finite numerical test is used in place of the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The budget-optimized diffusion speeds up both mean completion and the late survivor tail, yet delays the rare fastest arrivals: an informative and physically relevant risk tradeoff not captured by a mean-only optimization. Exact parameters and a robust uniformly positive family make the phenomenon reusable in bounded search and heterogeneous transport design.
